cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shuffle towards me. Everyone reached the assembly point and nobody wandered off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take your spot by the door. You count all twelve; nobody's left before the headcount.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 manages crowd movement while claiming assembly success; A5 offers a position swap and recruits B to certify the trapped headcount.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cupboard becomes assembly point; B4 twelve blocking access becomes A5 count with no early departures.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 want to get out and describe the precise access constraint.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4 crowd size and inability to exit into a completed final check.

specificity.evidence: B2 locked cupboard and B4 twelve bodies make the absurd drill outcome spoken and concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 position offer and count request both try to keep B cooperating with A success story.
